assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide scrolling background for a side-scrolling Brazilian street beat-em-up game. Primary request: an original atmospheric Brazilian downtown street at night, hand painted realistic arcade game background. Composition: panoramic horizontal 3:1 landscape, flat side-on camera perpendicular to storefront facades, NO vanishing point road receding into distance. Entire bottom 38 percent is unobstructed wide wet asphalt pavement where game characters can walk left/right AND up/down. Sidewalk curb at 62 percent height. Top 62 percent dense weathered Brazilian storefront facades, bar with warm orange neon 'BRASA', blue closed corrugated garage, small corner market, graffiti, electrical wires, moody apartment windows and palm silhouettes. Cinematic orange/amber shop light contrasts deep petrol blue night. Beautiful texture, subtle puddle reflections, gritty stylish game atmosphere. Constraints: EMPTY STREET, NO PEOPLE, NO CHARACTERS, NO vehicles in foreground, NO HUD, no logos from existing games, no title. Architectural horizontal elevation, game stage, landscape 3072x1024.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent enemy sprite atlas for a 2.5D street fighting beat-em-up game with semi-realistic photographic player sprites. Create 4 columns and 2 rows on a transparent 2048x1024 canvas, eight equal 512x512 cells, each containing ONE isolated full body adult male fictional street enemy facing RIGHT. Each character centered at x=256 of own cell, soles baseline y=480 within cell, head near y=45, consistent body scale about 430px tall. Feet and hands fully visible with ample transparent space, DO NOT CROSS CELL BOUNDARIES. Columns identities: 1 brown bomber jacket, dark jeans, short hair, black mask over mouth; 2 slim fast runner turquoise tracksuit and sneakers, black hood; 3 stocky muscular bald biker purple sleeveless leather vest and black trousers; 4 imposing gang boss red leather jacket black shirt gold chain, black gloves, sunglasses. Top row all four in boxing guard with both fists raised and knees bent facing right. Bottom row exact same four characters and clothing executing a straight right-facing punch, leading fist extended forward to the right, feet remain grounded. Lighting: warm amber key from left, cool blue rim, dark gritty cinematic rendered realistic illustration with textured clothing, convincing human anatomy and faces. Consistent side-on three quarter view as classic beat-em-up combat sprites. Constraints: exactly 4 equal columns 2 equal rows, actual transparent background, NO ground shadow, NO text, NO labels, NO borders, NO weapons, NO blood, no copyrighted game characters.
